name: TargetCursor-TS-TW
blurb: Spinning reticle cursor that locks onto hover targets.
description: Replaces the default cursor with a rotating target reticle. Tracks pointer movement, spins continuously, and scales/animates when hovering over designated targets.
use_when: Gaming interfaces, interactive dashboards, or sci-fi themed designs where a custom cursor enhances immersion.
avoid_when: Touch devices (detection included, disables); users relying on standard cursor expectations.
a11y: Custom cursor replacing default; no reduced-motion support. Mobile detection disables the feature.
